description: The pie chart presents the distribution of content categories referenced in the paper “Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models,” showing 11 slices in total. The largest slice is labeled “AI/NLP Research” in dark blue at 24.3%, followed by “Econ. & Fin.” in teal at 18.4%. Mid-sized slices include “History” in yellow at 8.2% and “Game&Anime” in orange at 8.2%, “Daily Life” in light cyan at 7.1%, “Med & Health” in green at 6.7%, “Science” in light blue at 6.7%, “Business” in red at 5.9%, “Pet & Animal” in light green at 5.5%, and “Law” in pink/red at 5.1%, with the smallest slices being “Geography” in yellow-green at 2.7% and “Math” in green at 1.2%. Percentages are printed next to each label with leader lines pointing to the corresponding slices; there is no separate legend, no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized, and the segments do not appear arranged strictly in descending size.
